svg.title: Cornerstone Web Team website redesign portfolio concept
svg.desc: Fictional web design portfolio concept for Cornerstone Web Team, showing website redesign wireframes and interface cards. Purpose-built demonstration visual for LocalPro Directory; it does not depict a real business, credential, review or completed client project.
